summary: The Wake began with seven deliberately varied records. This bootstrap run admits subjects into monitoring without claiming that any event changed after its original Soundings observation.
publicHighlights: Seven records now preserve a point-zero claim, its evidence state, unresolved questions, and explicit future checkpoints.
The initial cohort spans space science, game accessibility, energy policy, battery materials, climate reconstruction, archaeology, and game preservation.
Nine additional active candidates remain in the inbox rather than disappearing from the selection history.
Public-attention measurements remain unmeasured until a reproducible corpus and deduplication method are adopted.

admissions.reason: Admitted because a single launch opens into a long sequence of observable engineering, scientific, and institutional outcomes.
Admitted because the advertised accessibility design has a clearly identifiable future test and should not be judged only by promotional intent.
Admitted because the central claim can mature through peer review, independent replication, tariff design, and measured curtailment outcomes.
Admitted because it provides a clean laboratory baseline against which replication and practical scale-up can be compared.
Admitted because disagreement began at point zero and later evidence can show whether it narrows, deepens, or changes the original claim.
Admitted because the first report preserves unusually consequential unknowns that later epigraphy and material analysis may resolve.
Admitted because the project can be followed from announcement through technical comparison and eventually into evidence about audience and critical reach.

deferred.reason: Strong future release checkpoint, but the pilot already includes two game records and needed greater domain diversity.
A useful development baseline, deferred to keep the first cohort small; retain in the inbox for later promotion.
Consequential and provisional, but deferred while the pilot tests a different astronomy record with nearer operational milestones.

Specific and falsifiable, but its 2028 horizon is distant for the initial pilot.

Promising conservation questions, but Cova Dones offers a broader set of unresolved inscriptions and social interpretations.
